Union Road Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari has called the campaign against E20 petrol “paid propaganda.” Speaking at a CII event, Gadkari asked petrol vehicle owners whether their E20-compatible vehicles had broken down since the rollout of E20 engines in 2022. He said he could not find anyone in India who had reported such a failure and questioned the claims being made against ethanol-blended petrol.
